scope: Current SLOT IdVd case only; not a Vela global default
authorized_change: Carrier-row convergence becomes report-only. Stop on overall residual OR raw population-update error, with original global closure and boundary guards still required.

primary.rho: Vela normalizedBlockL2 with fixed initial block normalization, not the Sentaurus internal RHS norm
primary.delta_x: Pre-cap and pre-line-search stabilized Newton direction, transformed through parent-state Fermi derivatives into physical psi and population increments
primary.finite_step_update_error: Reported separately; not used for convergence

required_guards.closure_branch: Original implementation chooses relative or absolute according to source scale
required_guards.boundary: Preserve configured contact potentials and QF conditions and original acceptance checks
required_guards.domain: Preserve finite and positive population/domain checks

implementation.rhs_branch: Frozen Vela solver, row report mode and closure enforce mode
implementation.update_branch: External controller checks accepted snapshots. Conservatively requires both relative closure ratios <=0.01; then a zero-update original-boundary/closure audit must pass without changing the saved state numerically. A failure is not accepted.
